subject: Important Update: Your Travel Reservation
body: Dear [Recipient], We hope this email finds you well. We wanted to inform you that there has been a change in your upcoming travel itinerary. Your flight has been rescheduled to accommodate unforeseen circumstances. Please review the attached updated itinerary for the new details. If you have any questions or concerns, feel free to reach out to our customer service team. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your understanding. Safe travels! Best regards, Travel Agency Team
